QUOTE: The default `mbedtls_config.h` has `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` commented out (line 208), so a stock build calls libc directly.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that with MEMORY off (the default), platform.h:166-167 maps mbedtls_calloc/free to calloc/free, so a stock build calls libc directly with no indirection. It never uses the word "macro" for that branch, but "→ calloc / free from libc" carries the same substance.
